dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the wide mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle, with a pronounced decrease in 2D width in the final third of the visible frame.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low density; minor low-frequency darker pixel clusters are localized primarily toward the posterior lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; shading transitions between the primary white surface and darker posterior areas exhibit low gradient slopes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent linear white mark is visible on the anterior dorsal quadrant, oriented diagonally to the body axis. Additional faint linear markings (potential rake marks) are present along the dorsal midline.
